newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 9.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China's reform of the state enterprise sector has made great progress with 30 firms specially tracked by the State Commission for Economic Restructuring all having set up new administrative structures.
- Companies listed since 1996 are performing better than firms listed earlier.
- The Shanghai Stock Exchange has set up a branch in Guangzhou to strengthen supervision and provide better service to local brokerages, listed companies and investors.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China grain output for the summer season will be no lower than the 1996 harvest with area planted with grain reaching 31.88 million hectares, up 333,500 hectares against 1996.
